title: kit.args reference shapes
description: Editor-schema companions to ${{ kit.args.* }}. Capability config fields that pin a literal grammar (byte-size, absolute path, port, …) accept these shapes alongside that grammar so an authored descriptor validates before create-phase expansion — matching the Go validator's lenient path for parameterized entries (SPEC-v3 §6). The Go validators stay literal-only; ValidateEffective runs them after expansion.

whole.description: A string that is exactly one ${{ kit.args.<name> }} reference. Whole-value references adopt the arg's type at create (SPEC-v3 §6).

bearing.description: A string that embeds at least one ${{ kit.args.<name> }} reference (for example a path prefix).
